name: wouaff-client
description: Wouaff — le réseau social français et souverain
author: Biston

scripts.dev:electron: npm run gen:splash && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build:electron: npm run build && npm run gen:splash && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:electron:mac: npm run build && npm run gen:splash && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:electron:linux: npm run build && npm run gen:splash && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:electron:all: npm run build && npm run gen:splash && electron-builder --win --mac --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.publish:win: npm run build && npm run gen:splash && node scripts/publish.cjs --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
